This guide shows you how to set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, the complete infrastructure guide you need to receive crypto payments for your digital products without relying on Stripe.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stripe and Gumroad's failure to provide reliable payment infrastructure in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela leaves creators vulnerable to payment delays and rejection. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack with Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can take control of their payment pipeline, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe and PayPal. This guide shows you how to set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, enabling you to receive crypto payments for your digital products without relying on Stripe.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll need to sign up for a NOWPayments account, which provides access to 300+ cryptocurrencies and a 0.5% fee. You'll also need to set up a Cloudflare account to create Workers, which will handle the webhooks and payment processing. Additionally, you'll need to configure Supabase to store order information and Cloudflare Pages to host your digital products. With these components in place, you'll be ready to deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and start receiving crypto payments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deployed, you'll need to configure NOWPayments webhooks to receive notifications of incoming payments. You'll also need to set up Cloudflare Workers to process these payments and deliver digital products to customers. By integrating NOWPayments with Cloudflare Workers, you'll be able to automate the payment and delivery process, eliminating the need for manual intervention. This integration will also enable you to receive USDT payments on Tron and Solana, with network fees under $0.10 and average transaction fees of fractions of a cent, respectively.
USDT payments on Tron and Solana take significantly less time to arrive than PayPal payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and configured NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, you'll be ready to go live and start processing transactions. To do this, you'll need to test your payment pipeline with a sample transaction, ensuring that payments are being properly processed and digital products are being delivered to customers. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll also be able to configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to protect your domain from spam and phishing attacks. By following these steps, you'll be able to go live and start processing transactions with confidence.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is running, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transactions. To do this, you'll need to upgrade your Cloudflare account to support more Workers and add more storage to your Supabase instance. You'll also need to configure your NOWPayments account to support more cryptocurrencies and increase your payment limits. By scaling your infrastructure, you'll be able to handle increased demand and provide a seamless payment experience for your customers.
